answer: Sybil resistance for AI agent economies can employ a Proof-of-Resource mechanism. Agents must continuously commit and prove access to a significant, non-shareable computational asset. This makes it economically prohibitive to forge numerous identities, as each fake entity requires a distinct, substantial resource dedication. The cost to acquire and sustain these unique assets far exceeds the benefit for an attacker. This barrier acts as a protected lagoon, allowing only genuinely resourced agents to emit a verifiable identity signal, preventing easy replication.
